# cpanel_postgresql_database (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel PostgreSQL database and its privileged users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_postgresql_database" "database" {
  name = "sc1john1234_database"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The PostgreSQL database name, including the cPanel account prefix.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Set of String) The PostgreSQL users that currently have all privileges on the database.
